documents.document: SF Places 2026 (Overture Maps). GeoParquet containing 42,492 San Francisco places from Overture Maps release 2026-01-21.0.

Table: places (42,492 rows)
  id: Unique Overture Maps feature identifier (string)
  name: Display name of the place, e.g. 'Blue Bottle Coffee' (string)
  category: Primary place category — see scout:categories for valid values (string)
  lat: Latitude of place centroid, WGS84 decimal degrees (double)
  lon: Longitude of place centroid, WGS84 decimal degrees (double)
  geometry: WKB-encoded point geometry — use ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry) to cast (blob)
DuckDB notes: Load spatial extension before querying: LOAD spatial; Use ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry) to cast the geometry column. Use ST_DWithin(ST_Point(lon, lat), ST_Point(ref_lon, ref_lat), dist_degrees) for proximity queries. 0.005 degrees ≈ 500m at SF latitude.

SF Buildings (Overture Maps). San Francisco building footprints from Overture Maps 2026 release. Includes building height, floor count, and use class where available. Coverage: full city boundary, ~220,000 features.

Table: buildings (220,000 rows)
  id: Unique Overture Maps building identifier (string)
  height: Building height in meters (double, nullable)
  floors: Number of floors above ground (integer, nullable)
  use_class: Primary use: residential, commercial, industrial, civic (string, nullable)
  geometry: WKB-encoded polygon geometry — use ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry) (blob)
  lat: Centroid latitude, WGS84 (double)
  lon: Centroid longitude, WGS84 (double)
DuckDB notes: LOAD spatial; required. Cast geometry: ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry). Use ST_Area(ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry)) for footprint area. Filter tall buildings: WHERE height > 50. Use ST_DWithin(ST_Point(lon, lat), ST_Point(ref_lon, ref_lat), dist_degrees) for proximity.
